A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the full analytic results for the amplitudes are presented in this paper, which are the first analytic results for one-loop amplitides with a Higgs bosons in the final state.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Higgs plus jet amplitudes are rational functions of the kinematic variables, and thus can be used to construct a basis of one-loop integrals for the Higgs plus two jets process.
